versions.changelog:
baoyu-slide-deck-2 version 0.1.0

- Initial release of the baoyu-slide-deck skill.
- Generate professional slide deck images from provided content.
- Offers style presets, audience targeting, language selection, and slide count customization.
- Supports PowerPoint (PPTX) and PDF export.
- Includes robust workflow, file structure, and auto style selection based on content type.
- Designed decks are optimized for reading and sharing, with all visual and layout options documented.
